criteria.criterion: Access Coursera Data Science browse/search results without signing in
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent accessed Coursera browse/results pages and could see course cards without being forced to sign in. Baseline stands.

criteria.criterion: Apply all requested Coursera filters (Data Science subject, Beginner level, English language, 1–3 months duration) or document unavoidable UI limitations
criteria.final_justification: The required filters English, Courses, Beginner, and 1–3 Months are explicitly verified in the latest screenshot via filter chips. Data Science subject is supported by the action history starting URL and early screenshot (Screenshot 1) showing the Data Science browse page; later chips don’t explicitly repeat it, but the subject constraint is reasonably satisfied by being in the Data Science browse context. Keep full credit.

criteria.criterion: Identify the three highest-rated matching courses (or report fewer if not available)
criteria.final_justification: The agent provided three matching courses with ratings, but there is no evidence the page was sorted by rating or that these are the three highest-rated among all matches (only that they are three visible results). This warrants partial credit (identified 3 matching courses, but “highest-rated” not verified). Increase from baseline 2 to 3 due to screenshot support that these courses/ratings were real and under the applied filters.
